name: Skull Crusher
common_faults: bar path going to forehead instead of behind the head
partial ROM not reaching full stretch

substitutions.note: cable version; constant tension; less elbow stress
compound push; adds chest and shoulder demand

contraindications: acute elbow pain aggravated by loaded tricep stretch
resistance_profile: hardest at the bottom with arms angled behind the head (long-head stretch); decreases at lockout

provenance.notes: Trains tricep long head in the lengthened position — high local stimulus. EZ bar reduces wrist stress vs straight bar. SFR heuristic.
